subject: a wiry Japanese artist of the Edo period with a shaved head, deep-set intent eyes and strong hands, wearing a plain dark cotton kimono, holding an ink brush

panels.01-edo: a small Japanese boy kneeling on tatami in a modest Edo townhouse in the 1760s, drawing a cat and a flower with a brush on scrap paper, a mirror-maker's workbench with round bronze mirrors behind him, warm lamplight, wide establishing feeling of an old wooden Edo street through the open shoji
panels.02-carver: a Japanese teenage apprentice in a simple kimono bent over a cherry-wood block, carving fine lines with a small chisel in a crowded Edo woodcarver's workshop, wood shavings, an older craftsman watching, 1770s Japan
panels.03-studio: a lean young Japanese artist of eighteen in a plain dark kimono, hair tied in an Edo topknot, at a low desk in a busy 1770s Edo print-designer's studio, sketching a kabuki actor's pose from a costumed model, other apprentices grinding ink, an older master inspecting a drawing
panels.04-manga: a middle-aged {S} seated on the veranda of a Nagoya house in 1814, filling sheets with many small sketches of people, birds, fish and plants, friends and pupils leaning in to watch with delight, scattered papers around him
panels.05-daruma: {S} in a temple courtyard in Nagoya in 1817 walking across an enormous sheet of paper laid on the ground, painting with a broom-sized brush from a tub of ink, a huge crowd watching from around the courtyard and from ladders, only rough sweeping ink strokes visible on the paper, festive and dignified
panels.06-fuji: an elderly {S} with a grey stubble kneeling at a low desk by an open window, carefully drawing a new landscape design with a fine brush, a distant snow-capped Mount Fuji seen calmly through the window, sheets of rough sketches of hills, trees and travelers around him, a publisher and a block cutter waiting respectfully, Edo 1830s, quiet focus
panels.07-fire: an old {S} in a small bare rented room in 1839, working again at a makeshift desk after a fire, using pieces of a broken bottle as ink dishes, a few charred scrolls beside him, determined calm expression, morning light
panels.08-obuse: a very old {S} in a merchant's workshop in Obuse in 1844, painting a large wooden ceiling panel of swirling clouds and a dragon's coiling tail, a younger patron in fine kimono and an assistant holding a lamp, mountain village beyond, dignified and full of energy
